title: What any matrix-multiplication rank claim must address

requirements.statement: The term list satisfies every cubic Brent parity equation for the declared tensor format over the declared field.
requirements.rationale: The decomposition is the claim; without exact satisfaction of the tensor equations there is no scheme at all.

requirements.statement: The scheme's rank is at or below the bound relevant to the claim (published best for a record match, below it for an improvement).
requirements.rationale: A decomposition only advances the frontier if its term count is at or below the current bound.

requirements.statement: The scheme's greedy pair-CSE addition count is at or below the declared additions-record ask.
requirements.rationale: Additions dominate the constant-factor cost of the scheme; beating the published convention-bound is an independent record.
